Application Instructions
The application for graduate study in mathematics consists of the Graduate School Application, together with some specific math department requirements. The Graduate School Application must be submitted online and can be found at the Graduate School's application page.
Instructions for filling out the online application are on the first page of the application. You will be asked to submit:
Personal information/addresses
Degree program (PhD or MS) that you are applying for. You do not need an MS degree to apply for the PhD
Education and work history
Transcripts. The Graduate School requires official transcripts before you can be officially admitted. For the purposes of departmental evaluation, you should upload an unofficial transcript (for instance a scanned copy in PDF format) in the attachment section for each school you've attended.
GRE scores are not required. If you would like to submit GRE scores, they should be submitted in the test scores section and official scores should be sent by Educational Testing Service to the LSU Graduate School. .
English proficiency. International students whose native language is not English and/or who have been educated outside of the U.S. in a country or province where English is not the only official language must demonstrate proof of English proficiency by submitting scores from the TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), or PTE (Pearson's Test of English).
This is a Graduate School requirement. The minimum scores needed for admission are:
TOEFL: 79 on the internet based exam, 550 on the paper based exam, or 213 on the computer-based test.
IELTS: 6.5
PTE: 59
Duolingo: 110
Use ETS Institution Code 6373 (Graduate Business Organization) to have an agency send scores to LSU.
Three letters of recommendation from persons who are familiar with your qualifications to study graduate mathematics. On the Graduate School application, you will be asked for the names and email addresses of those you have asked to write letters. The individuals that you list will receive an email with the necessary information for them to upload the documents.
Personal statement of purpose or objectives. It is preferred that this be uploaded in the attachment section as a PDF file.
Upload a brief summary of previous teaching and research experience.
A list of mathematics courses taken. Include the course name, text(s), instructor, and the grade received. You should use the following fillable math coursework information form. After completing the form, print it as a PDF, or print and scan it to a PDF, and upload in the attachment section. Some browsers do not allow for saving PDF forms directly; hence the need to print first..
Resume/CV
A writing sample is not required by the Math Department, but submitting one can help in the evaluation of your application. A writing sample may consist of an MS thesis or other writing of mathematical nature. Or it could be any sample of your choice that you would like the evaluation committee to see.
Application Deadlines
Fall Admission
January 15: Priority Deadline for Submission of Application for Admission and Financial Aid for Fall
Spring Admission
Some years, a few students may be admitted for Spring, but this is not the norm. Please check the LSU Graduate School web page for deadlines.
